summary: Completed comprehensive testing of MEBO Payroll System's new user management features with role-based permissions. All backend APIs (26/26) and frontend functionality working correctly. Admin can manage users and has full access, while viewers have read-only access with export capabilities.
passed_tests: Admin login with admin@example.com/admin123 - role badge shows 'admin'
Users button visible in header for admin only
Users page loads with user list showing existing users
Create viewer user: email=test.viewer@demo.com, password=test123, name=Demo Viewer, role=viewer
New viewer user appears in list with 'viewer' badge
Viewer login with test.viewer@demo.com/test123 - role badge shows 'viewer'
Viewer does NOT see 'Users' button in header
Viewer does NOT see 'New Event' button on events page
Viewer does NOT see delete buttons on events
Viewer can navigate to event detail page and view all tabs
Viewer cannot see Add Employee form in Employees tab
Viewer cannot see edit/delete buttons for employees
Viewer cannot see Save Day button in day tabs
Viewer time entry inputs are read-only (cannot edit hours)
Viewer cannot see Save Information button in Info tab
Viewer CAN see and use export buttons (Excel/PDF) - correct behavior
Admin login restores full controls - all admin features visible
Backend API tests - all 26 endpoints passed including user management:
- GET /api/users (admin only) - lists users
- POST /api/users (admin only) - creates new users
- PUT /api/users/{id} (admin only) - updates user details
- DELETE /api/users/{id} (admin only) - deletes users
Role-based API permissions working correctly:
- Viewer can access GET endpoints (events, employees, time-entries, daily-statement, sum-totals)
- Viewer blocked from POST/PUT/DELETE endpoints (403 Forbidden)
- Admin has full access to all endpoints
All existing payroll functionality (auth, events, employees, time entry, calculations, exports) still working
